title: A tandem approach for waste-to-nanomaterial transformation towards polyethylene recycling
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00861A, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanan Huang, Chi-Linh Do-Thanh, Zhenzhen Yang, Sheng Dai, Hao Chen
Polyethylene was recycled into carbon materials via tandem cross-linking and carbonization using sodium amide, enabling C–H bond cleavage and C–N bond formation, and these materials showed good performance in gas separation and energy storage.
